## 用于生产

**2个物品的组件** — 所有在制造中使用它的物品:

```mermaid
graph LR
    a["Colqual target marker"]:::current
    b["Pulsus target marker"]:::prod
    a --> b
    click b "/zh-CN/content/items/named3-target-painter/" "Pulsus target marker"
    c["Pulsus target marker prototype"]:::prod
    a --> c
    click c "/zh-CN/content/items/named3-target-painter-pr/" "Pulsus target marker prototype"
    classDef current fill:#2f9e6f,stroke:#1f6f4a,color:#ffffff
    classDef prod fill:#3b6ea5,stroke:#274a75,color:#ffffff
    classDef more fill:#39445a,stroke:#54658a,color:#d5dbe8
```
